chart.title: Weekly working hours
chart.subtitle: Work hours of full-time production workers (male and female) in non-agricultural activities

Working hours per week.descriptionShort: Average working hours per week for full-time production workers in non-agricultural activities.
Working hours per week.descriptionKey:
- This data only includes full-time production workers (male and female) in non-agricultural activities.
- The researchers Huberman and Minns collected the data from multiple sources: establishment level surveys by the U.S. Department of Labor, the International Labor Organization and several independent researchers.
Working hours per week.descriptionProcessing: We estimated the values in the year 2000 as the average between males and females, as this is the only year for which there is no national average available in the original dataset.
Working hours per week.citationShort: Huberman and Minns (2005) – with major processing by Our World in Data
Working hours per week.citationLong: Huberman and Minns (2005) – with major processing by Our World in Data. “Working hours per week – Huberman and Minns” [dataset]. Huberman and Minns, “Working hours (Huberman and Minns, 2005)” [original data].
